true_answer: After all, you only care about whether Q is true in the case that P is as well. There are other techniques to prove statements (implications and oth- ers) that we will encounter throughout our studies, and new proof tech- niques are discovered all the time. Direct proof is the easiest and most elegant style of proof and has the advantage that such a proof often does a great job of explaining why the statement is true. Example 0.2.4 Prove: If two numbers a and b are even, then their sum a + b is even. Solution . Proof. Suppose the numbers a and b are even.
